features.description: Features and amenities toggle list. Each feature is a hidden+checkbox pair or a text input.
features.note: Feature ids are per site. List them from the create form.

gallery.description: Sortable image gallery. Each item has image_id, image_name, caption, url, cropping, focal_point.
gallery.note: Room 1 has 3 gallery images. Room 2 has 0. Items added/removed via UI.

layout_sections.description: Optional layout sections on the Layout tab. Per-page, not imported. Hashes are unique per section instance per page.
layout_sections.note: Layout sections are optional per page.

template_sections.note: Hash is page-specific, will differ on new pages

template_sections.note_2: Single image element, empty on template

layout_sections.note_2: Layout section IDs 22-24 are system/layout-only sections not in ACM channel index.

import.note: 15 ACM section templates can be imported. Room 1 has 0 imported sections. Room 2 has 0.

content_sections.note: No imported content sections on either template room. Sections are added per-page as needed.

assumptions: Element ids in layout sections and layout section hashes are page-specific; new pages get different ones
Gallery items are added through the UI; the profile records the field structure, not fixed ids
The 'filename' field (hero image) is set through the image picker, not text entry
Layout sections and gallery images are optional per page
Feature ids are per site: list them from the create form
_note: Default Cendyn CMS reference (v.11.4), derived from a demo site and cross-checked against one production site. Copy this folder to content-jobs/<site>/ and verify per site. page_level_fields confirmed on a production site (all present except rooms type_id, which is optional per site). Feature ids and section hashes are per site.
